"""Hierarchical address parser combining RTL administrative decomposition and component extraction."""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast

from loguru import logger

from ..cleaners import (
    clean_private_use_characters,
    collapse_whitespace,
    deduplicate_address_tokens,
)
from ..cleaners.contact_extractor import ContactExtractor
from ..cleaners.spelling_corrector import SpellingCorrector
from ..failure_classifier import FailureClassifier
from ..formatters.standard_formatter import AddressFormatter
from ..models import (
    AddressComponents,
    AddressFormat,
    AddressTargetFormat,
    BatchParsedAddressResult,
    GSOCodes,
    ParsedAddress,
    ParsedStreet,
    ParserConfig,
)
from ..streaming import chunk_iterable
from .macro_resolver import (
    AdminNodesResult,
    MacroAdminResolver,
)
from .street_parser import MicroStreetParser

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..quality.confidence import QualityScorer
    from ..validators.admin_validator import AdminValidator
    from ..validators.gso_models import (
        DistrictNode,
        ProvinceNode,
        WardNode,
    )


class HierarchicalAddressParser:
    """End-to-end hierarchical Vietnamese address parser and standardizer."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        admin_validator: AdminValidator | None = None,
        street_parser: MicroStreetParser | None = None,
        failure_classifier: FailureClassifier | None = None,
        formatter: AddressFormatter | None = None,
        quality_scorer: QualityScorer | None = None,
        config: ParserConfig | None = None,
        macro_resolver: MacroAdminResolver | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if admin_validator is None:
            from ..validators.admin_validator import AdminValidator

            self.validator = AdminValidator()
        else:
            self.validator = admin_validator
        self.street_parser = street_parser or MicroStreetParser()
        self.macro_resolver = macro_resolver or MacroAdminResolver(
            admin_validator=self.validator,
            street_parser=self.street_parser,
        )
        self.failure_classifier = failure_classifier or FailureClassifier()
        self.formatter = formatter or AddressFormatter()
        if quality_scorer is not None:
            self.quality_scorer = quality_scorer
        else:
            from ..quality.confidence import QualityScorer

            self.quality_scorer = QualityScorer()
        self.config = config or ParserConfig()

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Single Address Parsing & Decomposition
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def parse(
        self,
        address: str,
        *,
        config: ParserConfig | None = None,
        auto_correct: bool | None = None,
        extract_contact: bool | None = None,
        target_format: AddressTargetFormat | None = None,
        formatter: AddressFormatter | None = None,
    ) -> ParsedAddress:
        """Parse, decompose, and standardize a single raw Vietnamese address."""
        cfg = config or self.config
        use_auto_correct = cfg.auto_correct if auto_correct is None else auto_correct
        use_extract_contact = cfg.extract_contact if extract_contact is None else extract_contact
        use_target_format = cfg.target_format if target_format is None else target_format
        active_formatter = formatter or self.formatter
        return self._parse_address_fused(
            address,
            use_auto_correct=use_auto_correct,
            use_extract_contact=use_extract_contact,
            use_target_format=use_target_format,
            active_formatter=active_formatter,
        )

    def _parse_address_fused(
        self,
        address: str,
        *,
        use_auto_correct: bool,
        use_extract_contact: bool,
        use_target_format: AddressTargetFormat,
        active_formatter: AddressFormatter,
    ) -> ParsedAddress:
        """Fused single-address pipeline without per-call config/formatter resolution."""
        normalized_text, corrected_fields, raw_postal_code, recipient_name, phone = (
            self._preprocess_input(
                address, auto_correct=use_auto_correct, extract_contact=use_extract_contact
            )
        )
        (
            p_node,
            d_node,
            w_node,
            gso_codes,
            remaining_street,
            address_format,
            district_code,
            province_code,
            ward_name,
            district_name,
            province_name,
        ) = self._resolve_admin_nodes(normalized_text)

        (
            street_components,
            p_node,
            d_node,
            w_node,
            gso_codes,
            address_format,
            district_code,
            province_code,
            ward_name,
            district_name,
            province_name,
        ) = self._resolve_street_components(
            remaining_street=remaining_street,
            raw_text=normalized_text,
            raw_postal_code=raw_postal_code,
            recipient_name=recipient_name,
            phone=phone,
            p_node=p_node,
            d_node=d_node,
            w_node=w_node,
            gso_codes=gso_codes,
            address_format=address_format,
            district_code=district_code,
            province_code=province_code,
            ward_name=ward_name,
            district_name=district_name,
            province_name=province_name,
        )

        (
            p_node,
            d_node,
            w_node,
            gso_codes,
            district_name,
            ward_name,
            original_district,
            original_ward,
            corrected_fields,
        ) = self.macro_resolver.reconcile_admin_nodes(
            auto_correct=use_auto_correct,
            p_node=p_node,
            d_node=d_node,
            w_node=w_node,
            gso_codes=gso_codes,
            address_format=address_format,
            street_components=street_components,
            ward_name=ward_name,
            district_name=district_name,
            corrected_fields=corrected_fields,
        )

        legacy_district, legacy_districts = self.macro_resolver.resolve_legacy_districts(
            d_node, w_node, district_name
        )
        lat, lon = self.macro_resolver.resolve_centroid_coordinates(w_node, gso_codes)

        return self._assemble_parsed_address(
            address=address,
            normalized_text=normalized_text,
            active_formatter=active_formatter,
            street_components=street_components,
            p_node=p_node,
            d_node=d_node,
            w_node=w_node,
            gso_codes=gso_codes,
            address_format=address_format,
            target_format=use_target_format,
            legacy_district=legacy_district,
            legacy_districts=legacy_districts,
            ward_name=ward_name,
            district_name=district_name,
            province_name=province_name,
            lat=lat,
            lon=lon,
            corrected_fields=corrected_fields,
            original_district=original_district,
            original_ward=original_ward,
        )

    def _preprocess_input(
        self, address: str, *, auto_correct: bool, extract_contact: bool = True
    ) -> tuple[str, list[str], str | None, str | None, str | None]:
        """Sanitize raw address string, extract contact info, strip chat noise, and correct spelling."""
        corrected_fields: list[str] = []
        prescan_postal = self.street_parser.postal_code_re.search(address)
        raw_postal_code = prescan_postal.group(1) if prescan_postal else None
        recipient_name: str | None = None
        phone: str | None = None
        cleaned_input = clean_private_use_characters(address)
        if extract_contact:
            recipient_name, phone, cleaned_input = ContactExtractor.extract_contact(
                cleaned_input, clean_chat=auto_correct
            )

        if auto_correct:
            cleaned_input, typo_fixes = SpellingCorrector.correct_spelling(cleaned_input)
            if typo_fixes:
                corrected_fields.append("spelling")

        raw_clean = deduplicate_address_tokens(cleaned_input.strip(" ,-[]'\""))

        return normalized_text, corrected_fields, raw_postal_code, recipient_name, phone

    def _resolve_admin_nodes(self, normalized_text: str) -> AdminNodesResult:
        """Decompose administrative hierarchy from right to left via MacroAdminResolver."""
        return self.macro_resolver.resolve_admin_nodes(normalized_text)

    def _resolve_street_components(
        self,
        *,
        remaining_street: str,
        raw_text: str | None = None,
        raw_postal_code: str | None = None,
        recipient_name: str | None = None,
        phone: str | None = None,
        p_node: ProvinceNode | None,
        d_node: DistrictNode | None,
        w_node: WardNode | None,
        gso_codes: GSOCodes,
        address_format: str,
        district_code: str | None,
        province_code: str | None,
        ward_name: str | None,
        district_name: str | None,
        province_name: str | None,
    ) -> tuple[
        AddressComponents,
        ProvinceNode | None,
        DistrictNode | None,
        WardNode | None,
        GSOCodes,
        str,
        str | None,
        str | None,
        str | None,
        str | None,
        str | None,
    ]:
        """Decompose street components and apply postal code / homonym anchoring."""
        street_components = self.street_parser.parse(
            remaining_street,
            district_code=district_code,
            province_code=province_code,
            ward_code=gso_codes.ward_code if address_format == "NEW_2TIER" else None,
            raw_text=raw_text,
            raw_postal_code=raw_postal_code,
            recipient_name=recipient_name,
            phone=phone,
        )

        if street_components.postal_code and (p_node is None or d_node is None or w_node is None):
            (
                p_node,
                d_node,
                w_node,
                gso_codes,
                address_format,
                district_code,
                province_code,
                ward_name,
                district_name,
                province_name,
            ) = self.macro_resolver.anchor_by_postal_code(
                street_components.postal_code,
                p_node=p_node,
                d_node=d_node,
                w_node=w_node,
                gso_codes=gso_codes,
                remaining_street=remaining_street,
                address_format=address_format,
                ward_name=ward_name,
                district_name=district_name,
                province_name=province_name,
                district_code=district_code,
                province_code=province_code,
            )

        street_components = self.macro_resolver.reconcile_homonymous_street_or_building(
            street_components,
            ward_name=ward_name,
            remaining_street=remaining_street,
            district_code=district_code,
            province_code=province_code,
        )

        return (
            street_components,
            p_node,
            d_node,
            w_node,
            gso_codes,
            address_format,
            district_code,
            province_code,
            ward_name,
            district_name,
            province_name,
        )

    def _assemble_parsed_address(
        self,
        *,
        address: str,
        normalized_text: str,
        active_formatter: AddressFormatter,
        street_components: AddressComponents,
        p_node: ProvinceNode | None,
        d_node: DistrictNode | None,
        w_node: WardNode | None,
        gso_codes: GSOCodes,
        address_format: str,
        target_format: AddressTargetFormat = "ORIGINAL",
        legacy_district: str | None,
        legacy_districts: list[str],
        ward_name: str | None,
        district_name: str | None,
        province_name: str | None,
        lat: float | None,
        lon: float | None,
        corrected_fields: list[str],
        original_district: str | None,
        original_ward: str | None,
    ) -> ParsedAddress:
        """Construct full ParsedAddress payload with components, formatting, and quality score."""
        is_reformed = False
        resolved_address_format = address_format

        # Format projection according to requested target_format
        if target_format == "NEW_2TIER" and address_format == "LEGACY_3TIER":
            reform_ward_name = (
                self.validator.resolve_reform_ward_name(gso_codes.ward_code or "")
                if gso_codes.ward_code
                else None
            )
            ward_name = reform_ward_name or ward_name
            district_name = None
            resolved_address_format = "NEW_2TIER"
            is_reformed = True
        elif target_format == "LEGACY_3TIER" and address_format == "NEW_2TIER":
            if legacy_district and not district_name:
                district_name = legacy_district
                resolved_address_format = "LEGACY_3TIER"

        components = AddressComponents(
            house_number=street_components.house_number,
            lane_or_alley=street_components.lane_or_alley,
            street=street_components.street,
            is_street_verified=street_components.is_street_verified,
            canonical_street=street_components.canonical_street,
            street_type=street_components.street_type,

    )

    is_admin_verified: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Whether administrative units were successfully resolved against GSO",
    )
    # ── Address Format Detection (Vietnam 2025 Administrative Reform) ──────────
    address_format: AddressFormat = Field(
        default="UNKNOWN",
        description=(
            "Detected address format: LEGACY_3TIER = pre-2025 format with district level, "

            "UNKNOWN = could not determine"
        ),
    )
    legacy_district: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Best-effort legacy district name from the pre-2025 GSO tree. "

            "reform mapping yields an unambiguous or primary historical district."

    legacy_districts: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,

            "All historical district names associated with this location. "

    )

        default=None,
        description=(
            "Populated when parsing is incomplete or failed. "
            "Provides machine-readable failure code and human-readable explanation."
        ),
    )
